quote: Signed a significant 3-year contract to provide well construction technology for YPF Argentina to support the Vaca Muerta unconventional shale development in the country. YPF will utilize the Lucida RSS technology along with PermaFORCE drill bits to support efficiently drilling longer and deeper wells in a single run.
note: Opened Baker Hughes Q1 2026 English results; distinct from Halliburton ZEUS completions.
